ApplicationInfo.description: Application and boundary-version information exposed by the platform core.

application_id.description: Stable application identity used by desktop packaging.

protocol_version.description: Transport contract version expected by compatible clients.

version.description: Semantic version of the running platform core.

instance_id.description: Opaque identifier for the running sidecar instance.

schema_version.description: Schema generation used by this bootstrap response.

supervision_nonce.description: Opaque nonce unique to this supervision session.

supervisor_process_id.description: Process identifier of the supervising desktop process.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared with the operation being cancelled.

request_id.description: Identifier unique to this cancellation request.

accepted.description: Whether the host accepted cancellation for a non-terminal operation.

correlation_id.description: Identifier copied from the cancellation request.

operation_id.description: Operation targeted by the cancellation request.

request_id.description: Identifier copied from the cancellation request.

ClientHello.description: First authenticated request sent by the Flutter desktop.

client_name.description: Stable client name, such as the GixGiz desktop shell.

client_version.description: Semantic version of the desktop client.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared by the handshake response and any safe failure.

protocol_max.description: Newest protocol version accepted by the client.

protocol_min.description: Oldest protocol version accepted by the client.

request_id.description: Identifier unique to this handshake request.

requested_capabilities.description: Optional capabilities requested for this launch session.

CoreHello.description: Successful protocol and capability negotiation returned by the core.

application.description: Identity and versions compiled into the running core.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier copied from the client hello.

instance_id.description: Opaque identifier for this sidecar process instance.

request_id.description: Request identifier copied from the client hello.

selected_protocol.description: Protocol version selected from the overlapping supported ranges.

supported_capabilities.description: Capabilities supported by this internal core build.

CorrelationId.description: Identifier shared by events and failures from one logical operation.

ErrorCategory.description: Stable failure taxonomy used across GixGiz process boundaries.

oneOf.description: Input failed validation.
The caller lacks permission for the requested operation.
The requested capability is not supported.
A required resource or service is currently unavailable.
Current state conflicts with the requested operation.
A bounded resource is exhausted.
The operation was cancelled.
The operation exceeded its deadline.
Integrity verification failed.
A component or protocol version is incompatible.
The operation completed with reduced capability.
An internal failure has no safer specific category.

HealthRequest.description: Authenticated request for current platform status.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared by the response and any safe failure.

HealthResponse.description: Current authoritative core status with boundary identifiers.

status.description: Version and readiness reported by the running platform core.

InstanceId.description: Opaque identifier for one running core instance.

OperationId.description: Opaque identifier for one core operation.

PlatformStatus.description: Combined version and readiness response produced by the platform core.

application.description: Identity and version information for the responding core.

readiness.description: Current readiness plus its supporting service evidence.

ReadinessReport.description: Overall readiness plus the complete evidence used to calculate it.

services.description: Complete service evidence used for the calculation.

status.description: Overall readiness calculated from all service evidence.

summary.description: Safe plain-language explanation of the calculated status.

ReadinessStatus.description: Overall readiness calculated from explicit service evidence.

oneOf.description: Every mandatory service is healthy and no service is impaired.
The core is usable, but at least one capability is impaired.
A mandatory service is not currently available.
A mandatory service reported an explicit failure.
A newer peer supplied an unrecognized readiness value.

RecoveryAction.description: Recommended safe next action for a boundary failure.

oneOf.description: Retry the operation without changing configuration.
Restart the affected GixGiz component.
Review and correct platform prerequisites.
Escalate using sanitized diagnostics.
No recovery action is necessary.
A newer peer supplied an unrecognized recovery action.

RecoveryGuidance.description: Plain-language recovery information safe to show to a user.

action.description: Stable action that a client may present or interpret.

message.description: Safe plain-language explanation of the next step.

RequestId.description: Identifier for one request within a wider correlated operation.

SafeErrorPayload.description: Error payload that excludes raw causes, private input, and provider output.

category.description: Stable broad classification of the failure.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared by related operations and events.

request_id.description: Identifier unique to the failed request.

ServiceHealth.description: Safe, provider-neutral health record for one platform service.

message.description: Optional safe explanation containing no raw provider output.

requirement.description: Whether the service is required for readiness.

ServiceHealthStatus.description: Health evidence reported by one provider-neutral service.

oneOf.description: The service passed its current health check.
The service is available with reduced capability.
The service cannot currently be reached or used.
The service reported an explicit failure.
A newer peer supplied an unrecognized health value.

ServiceRequirement.description: Whether a service is required for readiness or only improves capability.

oneOf.description: Readiness depends on this service.
The platform can remain available without this service.
A newer peer supplied an unrecognized requirement.

accepted.description: Whether the host accepted the shutdown signal.

correlation_id.description: Identifier copied from the shutdown request.

SupervisionNonce.description: Opaque nonce tying a sidecar to one desktop supervision session.

TestOperationEventKind.description: Stable kinds emitted by the deterministic foundation event operation.
